visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older woman with dark hair and a red floral apron stands in a tiled kitchen. She uses a metal spoon to mix diced potatoes, carrots, and corn in a silver metal bowl on a wooden cutting board. (2) She picks up a translucent white plastic measuring cup containing a small amount of clear liquid and holds it up to the camera. Behind her is a white tiled wall and an electric rice cooker on a metal shelf. (3) The woman uses a small pink plastic spoon to scoop white powder from a white plastic container into the bowl. She continues to mash the ingredients with the metal spoon, her hands moving vigorously. (4) She holds a tube of 桂冠 brand mayonnaise and squeezes the white contents onto the mashed potato salad in the bowl. She then transfers the salad to a white ceramic plate and applies more mayonnaise in a zig-zag pattern. (5) The camera moves to a wooden table where three plates are laid out: the finished potato salad, a plate of stir-fried cabbage, and two pieces of cooked salmon. The lighting is bright and even.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged female voice speaks with a friendly, casual tone, explaining how to cut potatoes. A younger male voice responds with short acknowledgments. The rhythmic clinking of a metal spoon hitting a bowl is clearly heard. (2) A sharp plastic handling sound occurs as the woman explains water measurements for the electric cooker. Her voice maintains a clear, professional narrative quality. (3) The sounds of mashing and scraping increase in frequency as the two speakers discuss seasoning with salt. The vocal pitch fluctuates naturally during the conversation. (4) A soft rustling and squeezing sound of a plastic tube is audible. The female voice discusses calorie content while continuing to mash, her articulation remaining very clear. (5) Both speakers erupt into loud, high-arousal laughter after the woman makes a joke about not wanting the video posted. The male voice continues to chuckle in the background. (6) The woman asks if she is 'powerful' in a warm, proud tone as she presents the dish. The recording ends with a final exchange of positive affirmations.
